issues: Accessibility error: role-img-alt – Image elements rendered on the empty dashboard and receipt capture screens lack alternative text. The scanner reports elements like `<div dir="auto" role="img" ...>` with no aria-label, aria-labelledby, or title attribute. Fix by providing accessible labels for all image/icon components (e.g., add `accessibilityLabel="Dashboard illustration"` to the Image component in EmptyState, add `aria-label` or `title` to FontAwesome icons, or set `accessible={true}` with `accessibilityLabel`), ensuring every `<div role="img">` has appropriate alternative text.
feedback: The acceptance tests passed, but static validation failed due to serious accessibility issues. Provide descriptive alternative text/ARIA labels for all image elements so the UI meets accessibility standards.
